entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're meeting up at Shibuya[n]Station, yeah? To talk[n]about the next target?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Wouldn't it be better to go[n]separately, just in case?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: We'll meet once we get there then.[n]Is that OK with you, Yusuke?

entries.speaker: Yusuke
entries.en: I don't have enough money[n]for the train ride home.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: I'm already in Shibuya, dude.[n]I ditched my afternoon classes.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: But man... It's still daytime,[n]and there's already a ton[n]of shady people here.

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We agreed on it at the bath house![n]Did the heat fry your brain!?
